nodes.label: Feature Execution SVG Icon
nodes.description: SVG icon depicting a rabbit/speed symbol on a rounded square background (44x44 viewBox). Used as a feature icon for 'execution' quality (fast trade execution). Contains a rabbit-shaped vector path with CSS variable stroke/fill for theming.

nodes.label: Icon Box (Rounded Rectangle Background)
nodes.description: 44x44 rounded rect (rx=14) with fill var(--fill-0, #A6A6A6) at 8% opacity, forming the icon background.

nodes.label: Rabbit/Speed Icon Paths
nodes.description: Vector paths forming a rabbit silhouette, symbolising fast/speed execution. Stroke uses CSS variable --stroke-0 (default black), stroke-width 2, with round linecap and linejoin.
